description: Live ticking countdown to any future date and time.

faqs.a: Every second with setInterval, from your device clock. It keeps ticking while the tab is open and stops at zero.
faqs.q: How often does the countdown update?

faqs.a: It shows a friendly message that the date has passed, instead of negative numbers.
faqs.q: What if the date is in the past?

faqs.a: No — it counts down in your browser only. Close the tab and it stops; nothing is stored or sent anywhere.

howto: Pick the future date and time.
Watch the days, hours, minutes and seconds tick down live.
title: Event Countdown Timer
